title: Property tie lines
description:
Property tie lines are graphical indicators that two or more lots are being treated by the BC Assessment Authority as one large parcel (these lots will have the same owner and share one assessment roll number).  Property tie lines is one dataset among many that provide information about property. Other related datasets can be found by filtering on the property keyword.

Data currency

This data in City systems is updated frequently in the normal course of business, however priorities and resources determine how fast a change in reality is reflected in the database.  The extract on this website is updated weekly.

Data accuracy

Much of the City's land base is created using survey accuracy however some features are not as precise.
